title: VAT matrix configuration package read-only discovery
purpose: Discover whether the Business Central Configuration Packages UI can include VAT Posting Setup / Table 325 as a standard setup-data route before any future import/apply action.
acceptanceCriteria: Configuration Packages UI is opened read-only in playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE or safely blocked.
The screenshot QA explains visible page, buttons, fields, and which actions are dangerous.
No package is created, imported, validated, applied, exported or published.
The result decides whether a later controlled configuration-package write case is realistic.

nextStepDecisionCard.lastEvidenceSummary: D18 selected read-only Configuration Packages discovery as the next non-grid standard route after D17 blocked lookup/select controls.
nextStepDecisionCard.reason: Configuration Packages are source-backed for setup data including VAT Posting Setup, but must be discovered read-only before any write.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: Read-only discovery can test the selected route without setup changes.
Only valid if D19 proves the required UI route, table/field visibility and stop conditions.
Posting Groups wait for a correct VAT matrix row or a conscious park decision.
Master data waits for VAT/posting defaults.

queueChangesMade: Selected D19 as the next read-only route discovery after D18.
nextStepDecisionCard.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: It tests a Microsoft-documented standard setup-data route without repeating fragile Page-472 grid writes.
risksBeforeNextCase: Configuration Packages can become effective if import/validate/apply actions are clicked.
Edit in Excel can publish changes and is forbidden in D19.
Screenshots must show the actual Configuration Packages page, not Tell-Me/search overlay.
requiredPreparation: Use direct safe navigation if a known page route exists; otherwise stop on ambiguous Tell-Me overlay.
Classify Import, Export, Validate, Apply and Edit in Excel as dangerous visible actions.
